name: Cognia Plugin Template Python
description: Python plugin template — two agent tools, a settings schema, and an A2UI context panel whose clicks come back through a hook. Replace this manifest with your own plugin's metadata.

permissionJustifications.python:execute: Runs this plugin's tools in the desktop Python host.
permissionJustifications.filesystem:read: Reads the plugin's own data directory, which is where the note file lives.
permissionJustifications.session:read: The context panel is declared for chat sessions, and every resource kind a panel names is gated on its own read permission.

browser.reason: Python plugins run in the desktop subprocess host.

mobile.reason: Python plugins run in the desktop subprocess host, which mobile does not have.

tools.name: template_echo
tools.description: Echo the supplied message back to the agent. Replace with your own tool.

tools.name: template_note
tools.description: Read or replace the plugin's saved note. Shows how a Python tool reaches the host through ctx.

text.description: New note text. Omit to read the current note.

tools.name: template_build_panel
tools.description: Build the context panel's A2UI surface. Invoked by the host when the panel is first shown.

resource.description: Resource the panel was opened for.
